01-token-cost.eyebrow: Agents for Humans · Debugging an agent's token bill
01-token-cost.title: 115,000 tokens in one step.
01-token-cost.sub: A tool's schema disagreed with the prompt, so the agent reverse-engineered it by watching the validator reject things. Every retry resent the whole conversation.

02-eventbridge.eyebrow: Agents for Humans · EventBridge Scheduler to Bedrock AgentCore
02-eventbridge.title: No operator. No browser.
02-eventbridge.sub: A one-shot schedule invokes the deployed runtime directly, with no Lambda in between, then deletes itself. The payload is raw JSON, whatever the CLI tells you.
02-eventbridge.caption: The runtime's own log, carrying the session id the schedule gave it

03-authority.eyebrow: Agents for Humans · Where the boundary is enforced
03-authority.title: It refuses.
03-authority.title_quiet:
Not because a prompt
told it to be careful.
03-authority.sub: Every tool the agent has is read-only. A hard guardrail runs before any policy is consulted, and a policy can only ever narrow what is allowed.
03-authority.caption: Same kit, one cheap accessory missing, and the serial does not match
